title: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement

tracker.notes: Arjun: 'our standard mutual NDA' - needed before 1 Oct data walkthrough. K: will sign tonight

verdict: Do not sign yet: 2 blocking issues to resolve

findings.title: 'Mutual' NDA that only binds AtliQ
findings.explanation: The title says mutual, but AtliQ is defined as the 'Recipient' and Confidential Information is only what the other side discloses. AtliQ's own architecture and pricing shared in the walkthrough would be unprotected.
findings.suggestion: Rewrite with reciprocal definitions (Disclosing Party / Receiving Party apply to both).
findings.quote: **ATLIQ TECHNOLOGIES PRIVATE LIMITED**, a company incorporated under the Companies Act, 2013 (CIN U72900MH2019PTC321456; GSTIN 27AAKCA4821F1Z3), having its registered office at 4th Floor, Baner Business Bay, Pune 411045, Maharashtra, India (the…
findings.precedent: GlobalMart (Mar 2026): they sent one-way, K: 'We only sign mutual — we'll be sharing our architecture too.' They agreed.

findings.title: Non-compete hidden inside an NDA
findings.explanation: This clause stops AtliQ serving the counterparty's competitors after the NDA ends. That is a business restriction, not confidentiality, and it would join the commitment register.
findings.suggestion: Delete. Confidentiality obligations already protect their information.
findings.quote: 8.1 In order to protect the Confidential Information, the Recipient shall not, during the term of this Agreement and for a period of twelve (12) months after its termination, provide services similar to those contemplated by the Proposed Transaction to any Competitor.

findings.title: 6-hour breach notification
findings.explanation: Very short notification window for a services vendor.
findings.suggestion: Ask for 'without undue delay and in any event within 72 hours'.
findings.quote: 6.2 The Recipient shall comply with the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 in respect of any personal data forming part of the Confidential Information, and shall notify the Company of any personal data breach within six (6) hours.

findings.title: Confidentiality lasts forever
findings.explanation: Perpetual obligations are hard to administer; 3-5 years (trade secrets longer) is AtliQ's usual term.
findings.suggestion: Limit to 3-5 years from disclosure, trade secrets for as long as they remain secret.
findings.quote: 7.2 The obligations of the Recipient under this Agreement shall survive termination and shall continue in perpetuity.
